_read_me: Allowlist for src/lib/db.admin-write-through.test.ts. Each key is a path under src/ that writes a chat-context-WATCHED model through `prismaAdmin` (which has no write-through extension — see the doc block on `prismaAdmin` in src/lib/db.ts) and deliberately does NOT call invalidateChatContext()/invalidateAllChatContext(). The value is the reason, written out and verified against the code, and it must name the columns written and the cached query that does not read them. There is exactly one legitimate reason to be here: nothing Sage caches changes as a result of this write. 'It is only one row', 'the TTL is short', and 'the student will refresh' are not reasons — the point of the write-through is that Sage answers from the cache without anyone refreshing anything. An entry here should be harder to write than the one-line invalidation call it avoids. The test also asserts every key still HAS such a write, so an entry that outlives its code fails rather than silently exempting whatever replaces it.
src/lib/advising-appointments.ts: Two `prisma.appointment.update` calls (the import is `prismaAdmin as prisma`), at the end of sendAppointmentConfirmation and inside the sendPendingAppointmentReminders loop. Both write exactly one column each — confirmationSentAt and reminderSentAt — which are email-delivery bookkeeping. The only cached read of Appointment is getSituationalSnapshot's `prisma.appointment.findFirst` (src/lib/sage/situational-snapshot.ts), inside the 180s `chat:snapshot` layer: it filters on studentId, startsAt >= now and status in (scheduled, confirmed), and selects title and startsAt only. Neither column is selected and neither is in the filter, so the snapshot Sage would build after these writes is byte-identical to the one it already has. Invalidating anyway would flush every reminded student's whole chat context on each nightly reminder sweep to produce the same answer. END THIS EXEMPTION if either column becomes readable in a cached surface, or if either call site starts writing anything else — status and startsAt in particular are both read above.
